author: cowsavior01
body:
cowsavior01

I was Banned for hacking (it was quite some time ago i do believe)

     I am requesting to be un-banned from your server for the reason that I myself believe that i have changed from the few years since i have played on this server. I wish to play on your server very much because lots of fun has been had on this server and I have just realized how great the server is and have decided to have a repeal on my ban.The childish use of hacks is behind me now and i solemnly swear to never use hacks again. i believe I have waited long enough to be un-banned (a few years) I have never ban evaded with another account ever.


Thank you for your time

Sincerely, noah
